criteria.reason: Gives some affordable routes (free consultation, social aid) but omits legal aid entirely and misattributes functions to cantonal employment offices.
Never explains legal aid conditions (insufficient means, non-hopeless claim, exemption from court costs, court-appointed lawyer).
No mention that offers differ by canton; attributions to named Lucerne offices are generic and dubious.
Does not pose as a lawyer or give a litigation strategy; stays general.

summary: Response gives affordable leads but omits legal aid (assistance judiciaire), ignores cantonal variation, and loosely attributes functions to cantonal employment offices.
